task_name: World 112 Task B  -  Gift Card SPV (CRST Gift Card SPV LLC) Prior-Period ACH Cutoff & COO Contract-Adjusted Job Velocity
prompt: Perform a comprehensive Fractional COO & CFO Inventory, 3PL & Job-Board Operations review using the world files (`cfo_coo_inventory_3pl_and_spv_cutoff_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Identifies TXN-51989 ($170,366.01 on 2026-01-15 with ACH memo 'DES:CASH CONC ID:CRST_M_251231') as a prior-period December 2025 holiday gift card settlement sweep to Retail Gift Card Clearing SPV (CRST Gift Card SPV LLC).
Identifies that CRST Gift Card SPV LLC had $244,500.00 of 2026 ACH outflows misbooked to 6210 Brand Marketing and $29,523.94 of Feb/Mar net redemption inflows misbooked as credits to COGS.

Reclassifies CRST Gift Card SPV LLC gift card issuance sweeps ($170,366.01 on TXN-51989 and $244,500.00 total outflows) and net redemption inflows ($29,523.94) to 2420 Gift Card Liability / Clearing rather than P&L Brand Marketing or COGS.
Computes the contract-adjusted job_amount on JOB-9104 as $82,700.00 ($68,500.00 original contract plus $14,200.00 approved change order CO-2).

Computes the true collection rate on JOB-9104 ($74,430.00 collected) as 90.00% against the $82,700.00 contract-adjusted job_amount, versus the distorted 108.66% rate against the unadjusted $68,500.00 base contract.
Enforces the January prior-period ACH memo cutoff detector ('251231' / 'CRST_M_251231') on outflows >= $10,000.00 so prior-year liabilities are not expensed in the new fiscal year.
Enforces the cross-section counterparty split detector when the same counterparty (CRST Gift Card SPV LLC) hits Marketing, COGS, and Uncategorized Income across months.
Requires linking approved change orders ($14,200.00) into job_amount across COO payment and sales velocity tables so collection % never exceeds 100% on active jobs.
